A two-glyph superscript *x*23 and a two-glyph subscript *y*45 sit in this sentence, as does an upright superscript *e*abc and the subscript *D*min that a narrower tolerance already admitted.

This paragraph carries no raised or lowered text at all. It is here to show that a baseline shift of a whole line still ends the line, which is the answer the same measurement gives in the other direction.
